description: 10-K risk factor changes (year over year) — What changed in a US public company's risk factors: compares Item 1A of its latest Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR with the prior year's 10-K (or an earlier pair with filing=1-3). Returns a change level MINIMAL / MODERATE / SUBSTANTIAL, word-count change, counts of unchanged / modified / new / removed blocks, the NEW risk statements (usually new risk-factor headings) and REMOVED ones, samples of brand-new paragraphs, and keyword themes with trends NEW / RISING / FALLING / DROPPED (AI, tariffs, cybersecurity, China, geopolitical conflict, rates, inflation, supply chain, regulation, privacy, taxes and more). Params: ticker (or cik), optional filing=0-3 (0 = latest vs prior). Source: SEC EDGAR (public domain). Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_risk_changes
